title: Add startup / shutdown methods to Agents in Core and AgentChat
body:
## What
Across many usecases, agents might need to provision some resources that take a while to startup (e.g., a db connection, a webbrowser instance, a code executor endpoint, a file handle etc). In some ways similar to how [FastAPI handles startup and shutdown via lifespan events. ](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/advanced/events/)
Similarly these resources need to be shut down once the agent is done running e.g., close a db connection, destroy a browser instance, close files etc.
This issue proposes adding some protocol spec to Agents in core and agentchat that requires agents to implement startup and shutdown methods that the runtime can call. 

## How 
Some proposed steps toward accomplishing this 

- [x] Design a protocol for startup/shutdown lifecycle methods
- [x] Update the core runtime to honor these methods
- [x] Update core and agentchat agent base agent classes to follow protocol
- [ ] Update example agents like websurfer, assistant agent in agentchat to use this design where appropriate
- [ ] Add documentation and examples for implementing startup/shutdown in custom agents 
- [ ] Consider cases for resource pooling and if the framework should enable this e.g., a browser instance 

This should not be a breaking change for any users of existing core or agentchat agents. However users of custom agents might need to implement these methods?

Related to #4699
